<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, carbon signals in the typical methyl region are observed at 57.20 ppm (likely an O‑CH₃), 41.00 ppm (likely an N‑CH₃), and three aliphatic methyl signals at 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm. This accounts for five distinct CH₃ carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
